definition.bgrej_definition: mistag [%] = 100 / BGrej at a fixed signal/tag efficiency
definition.display_name: Selection metric: average mistag at reference working points
definition.formula: arithmetic mean of mistag percentages for b-tag 0.80/0.90 and c-tag 0.50/0.80 working points
definition.note: Lower is better. This is the recommended fine-tuning selection metric for the current study.
definition.pair_definition: xy means x-tag signal efficiency with y-flavour background rejection
